units.source_zh: 刚过巳时，尽管如此，从半夜出来，惠琼就没有停下来过。

paragraphs.source_zh: 喝完酒，惠琼没有说一句话，就向蛙鼻进发了。他已没有一点儿自我意志，完全是在秀吉的精心策划下行动。刚过巳时，尽管如此，从半夜出来，惠琼就没有停下来过。

paragraphs.source_en: When he reached Kawabana, an immense lake measuring one hundred and ninety chō spread before him, and a warboat had long been waiting on its waters for his arrival.

units.source_en: When he reached Kawabana, an immense lake measuring one hundred and ninety chō spread before him, and a warboat had long been waiting on its waters for his arrival.
units.source_zh: 来到蛙鼻，眼前是一个一百九十町的大湖，湖面上早就准备好一只军船，正在等待他的到来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 来到蛙鼻，眼前是一个一百九十町的大湖，湖面上早就准备好一只军船，正在等待他的到来。

paragraphs.source_en: The sun shone upon the water, making the solitary castle floating upon its surface appear more forlorn than ever. Across the water, to the left of Mount Sarukake, Mōri Terumoto’s main camp could be seen; to the right stood Kikkawa Motoharu’s camp, half hidden among the green hills, its banners streaming in the wind.

units.source_en: The sun shone upon the water, making the solitary castle floating upon its surface appear more forlorn than ever.
units.source_zh: 太阳照在水面上，使得浮在水面上的孤城更是可怜。

units.source_en: Across the water, to the left of Mount Sarukake, Mōri Terumoto’s main camp could be seen; to the right stood Kikkawa Motoharu’s camp, half hidden among the green hills, its banners streaming in the wind.
units.source_zh: 对面猿挂山的左面，可以看见毛利辉元的大营，右边可望见掩映在青山之中的吉川元春的营盘，旌旗招展。

paragraphs.source_zh: 太阳照在水面上，使得浮在水面上的孤城更是可怜。对面猿挂山的左面，可以看见毛利辉元的大营，右边可望见掩映在青山之中的吉川元春的营盘，旌旗招展。

paragraphs.source_en: Kobayakawa Kagetaka was probably at Terumoto’s camp that day as well, discussing the state of the war; not one of the three would have dreamed that Ekei was even now crossing the waters on a mission to Takamatsu Castle.

units.source_en: Kobayakawa Kagetaka was probably at Terumoto’s camp that day as well, discussing the state of the war; not one of the three would have dreamed that Ekei was even now crossing the waters on a mission to Takamatsu Castle.
units.source_zh: 大概小早川景隆今天也在辉元那里议论军情，三个人做梦也不会想到，惠琼现在正在出使高松城的水面上。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大概小早川景隆今天也在辉元那里议论军情，三个人做梦也不会想到，惠琼现在正在出使高松城的水面上。

paragraphs.source_en: “Lord Abbot, do not forget: have the boat put out before noon and let Muneharu take his own life aboard it. We shall send out a boat from this side as well to inspect the body. The peace agreement must be concluded before the Hour of the Sheep. Be certain you do not forget—it must be noon.”

units.source_en: “Lord Abbot, do not forget: have the boat put out before noon and let Muneharu take his own life aboard it.
units.source_zh: “住持大师，别忘记了，正午之前让船下水，在船上让宗治自尽就行了。

units.source_en: We shall send out a boat from this side as well to inspect the body.
units.source_zh: 这边也会派出船去验尸。

units.source_en: The peace agreement must be concluded before the Hour of the Sheep.
units.source_zh: 未时之前谈妥议和之事。

units.source_en: Be certain you do not forget—it must be noon.”
units.source_zh: 一定别忘了，是正午。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “住持大师，别忘记了，正午之前让船下水，在船上让宗治自尽就行了。这边也会派出船去验尸。未时之前谈妥议和之事。一定别忘了，是正午。”

paragraphs.source_en: The instant Ekei stepped aboard, Hideyoshi gave him a slap, and Ekei could not keep his whole body from trembling.

units.source_en: The instant Ekei stepped aboard, Hideyoshi gave him a slap, and Ekei could not keep his whole body from trembling.
units.source_zh: 惠琼刚踩到船上，就被秀吉拍了一下，他不禁浑身颤抖。
